guard: running a mapped command against a real broker and manager compares the endpoint commands and input fields it issued with the owner rows: a row naming another command fails, an option map's keys are one value while an undeclared key under a structured field fails, and the most specific row the invocation's mode and flags select must have been issued
why: The execution half is what catches a wrong owner the offline grammar accepts; removing either comparison must redden the self-test that feeds it one.

mutations.name: an issued command is no longer compared with its owner
mutations.find: if (ownerOf(item)?.command !== run.command) problems.push(`cotal ${label} issued ${req.endpoint} ${req.command}, whose owner is ${map.owners[item] ?? "missing"}`);
mutations.expectRed: a row that names another command for manager ps fails on the same observation
mutations.cell: a row that names another command for manager ps fails on the same observation

mutations.name: an issued input field is no longer compared with its owner
mutations.expectRed: a field row that names another command fails on the models observation
mutations.cell: a field row that names another command fails on the models observation

mutations.name: keys under a field with no declared properties are graded as fields
mutations.expectRed: every request cotal spawn scout --detach --agent claude --opt effort=high issued matches its owner rows
mutations.cell: every request cotal spawn scout --detach --agent claude --opt effort=high issued matches its owner rows

mutations.name: must-issue applies only to rows naming exactly the invocation's flags
mutations.replace: && owner.flags.length === run.flags.length && within(owner.flags, run.flags) ? [{ item, flags: owner.flags }] : [];
mutations.expectRed: a models run that issued nothing fails on the row it should have issued
mutations.cell: a models run that issued nothing fails on the row it should have issued

mutations.name: a less specific row is no longer shadowed by the row the flags select
mutations.find: const shadowed = matching.some((other) => other.flags.length > flags.length && within(flags, other.flags));
mutations.expectRed: every request cotal ps --slots issued matches its owner rows
mutations.cell: every request cotal ps --slots issued matches its owner rows

mutations.name: every leading bare word counts as a mode word
mutations.find: if (`cli:${command} ${bare.slice(0, n).join(" ")}` in map.owners) words = bare.slice(0, n);
mutations.expectRed: positional values after a mode are not mode words
mutations.cell: positional values after a mode are not mode words
